definition: a place where a river drops steeply
description: At the edge of a huge waterfall in a rocky canyon, wide curtains of white water pour over a cliff into a deep gorge, throwing up clouds of spray with a rainbow in it. On the wet rock in front, a young man in a black tailcoat plays a shiny black grand piano with his coat tails flapping and spray blowing over him. Tourists in colourful rain ponchos stand behind a railing, and two people shelter under an umbrella.
